name: Voice of the Kraken (Recharges after a Short or Long Rest)
description: a creature speaks through the creature with a thunderous voice audible within 300 feet. Creatures of the creature’s choice that can hear the creature’s words (which are spoken in Abyssal, Infernal, or Primordial) must succeed on a DC 14 Wisdom saving throw or be frightened of the creature for 1 minute. A frightened target can repeat the saving throw at the end of each of its turns, ending the effect on itself on a success.
